title: Philips Hue Bridge
summary: Lighting through the bridge’s room groups.
body:
## Connect existing lighting

Set up the bridge and pair the bulbs using the manufacturer’s setup process. Organize lights into room groups, then add the Hue integration in Home Assistant.

## Verify the group

Check that the expected room entity responds to on/off and brightness changes before mapping it into DomoSenso. Ramka can show controls for configured light entities. No additional circuit wiring is specified by this component.

## Setup references

- [Philips Hue setup and room groups — Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/hue/)

These upstream instructions may evolve; the component versions and pinned source above record the DomoSenso scope.
